articles.description: The vessel sank off the coast of northern Sicily, killing seven people including British tech tycoon Mike Lynch.
articles.summary: There were 22 people on board the Bayesian at the time of the incident The crew of the Bayesian superyacht did not know about critical safety risks that left it vulnerable in powerful winds before it sank off the coast in northern Sicily, killing seven people, British investigators say.
key_points: British tech tycoon Mike Lynch, 59, and his daughter Hannah, 18, were among seven people who died when the vessel sank on 19 August 2024.

The sinking of the Bayesian unfolded with "extraordinary speed" when a violent downburst of freak hurricane-force winds knocked it onto its side in less than 15 seconds, the UK's Marine Accident Investigation Branch…
